newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares finish low-volume day at new record.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares finish low-volume day at new record.

text.p: 1455 GMT - Dutch shares finish at new closing high after day spent range-bound in record territory, but volumes thin with institutional investors remaining largely sidelined. Sentiment still positive, but players developing vertigo, dealers say.
* AEX closes up 10.09 points or 1.12 percent at record high of 907.19, back from new intraday high of 911.25.
* Chemicals firm DSM adds 5.50 guilders to 205.00 on fine chemicals acquisition in India.
* ABN AMRO adds 1.0 guilders to 39.40 helps index.
* Oce jumps ends up 7.40 guilders at 257.90 on first-half results at upper end of analyst forecasts.
